description: Dashboard with automatic red highlighting for overdue assignments. Completed assignments are not highlighted regardless of due date.

props.text: Dashboard with automatic red highlighting for overdue assignments. Completed assignments are not highlighted regardless of due date.
Displays all assignments in deadline-sorted order. Each assignment row shows title, unit code, due date, and completion status.
Red background or border styling applied to assignment rows where due date < current date AND completion status is not 'completed'. This visual treatment makes overdue items immediately recognizable.
Client-side logic that compares each assignment's due date against the current date/time on page load and continuously checks to ensure highlighting updates automatically as dates change.
Logic that prevents red highlighting from being applied to assignments marked as completed, regardless of their due date being in the past.
Timer or page visibility handler that re-evaluates overdue status when the page regains focus or at midnight boundaries, ensuring the red highlighting updates automatically each day.
